reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in the thread on his message in #central-random: the ticket is PD-4821.

Hollis posted it in #central-team on Jun 9, 2026, and Tobias is a member there. The Eastbank receiving-door import for Marrow Agrisupply (MAS) is attached to that ticket. The open issue at the time was that the import file labels doors E1/E2, but their booking sheet uses 01/02.

Other Marrow Agrisupply tickets came up in the search, but they're about different problems, so I left them out of the reply.
